_about: VJE glyph name -> upstream family folder in microsoft/fluentui-system-icons.
THE PARTITION IS STATED BY OMISSION. A name listed here is served by the vendored Microsoft
glyph; a name absent from here is served by VJE's own traced artwork under fluent/custom/.
There is deliberately no second list of the custom names to keep in step -- the icon set's
names are icon_names in src/vje_app/services/IconLibrary.hpp, and this file says which of them
Microsoft answers.
A GLYPH FAMILY IS AUDITED AS A UNIT, because a family's meaning comes from its members agreeing
with each other rather than from any one glyph. That is why several obvious-looking candidates
are absent:
- The six Add variants (vje-add-*). Microsoft ships Text Add and Stack Add but has no
Braces Add, Toggle Add, Prohibited Add or Number Symbol Add, so a vendored Add family would
be six glyphs that no longer read as one set.
- The four Convert To variants (vje-convert-*), which are the Add family one badge later and
fail for the same reason.
- vje-array. Checked across all 2,970 families, Microsoft has nothing for [], so the array
glyph stays VJE's own traced artwork.
CORRECTED 2026-08-14. This entry used to say that vendoring vje-object alone would split a
pair the tree shows side by side -- which was never true of the tree as shipped, since
vje-object HAS been vendored (as Braces) since the first pull. The reasoning survived from
a draft in which neither was. It is now moot in a second way: vje-object is the FOLDER, so
object and array were never going to be a matched pair of brackets, and spec TREE-03 has
said Object -> Folder, Array -> List/grid all along. Whether vje-array follows to a List or
Grid glyph is deliberately still open -- the folder is being tried on its own first.
- The three array transforms and vje-copy-pointer, which have no Fluent concept behind them.
A VENDORED NAME IS VENDORED AT BOTH DESIGN SIZES. Where upstream ships only one of 16 / 20,
that one design serves both and the puller reports it. Serving one design size from Microsoft
and the other from the custom tree would make a command's glyph change identity between the
tree (16) and the toolbar (20), which is the collision src/vje_app/CMakeLists.txt keeps the two
sub-trees on separate resource prefixes to prevent.
To re-pull:  python3 tools/pull_microsoft_icons.py --source <path to a fluentui-system-icons checkout>
